name: Technical Consultation
description: Distinguish advice, evidence, accepted recommendations and unresolved technical issues.

sections.title: Questions and Evidence
sections.instruction: Record the technical questions, evidence and constraints, retaining important details and source excerpts.

sections.title: Advice and Recommendations
sections.instruction: Attribute advice only where stated. Advice is not acceptance or a decision.

sections.title: Accepted Changes
sections.instruction: Include acceptance only when explicitly supported; preserve tentative and rejected alternatives.

sections.title: Next Steps and Gaps
sections.instruction: Record source-supported next steps and missing evidence. Do not invent ownership or deadlines.
